findings.title: N-step-grid: services.yaml thermal selectors keep the off-grid (min, step) pairs #1679 removed from the config flow
findings.claim: At 92d38ecb, 6 of 47 services.yaml number selectors (set_thermal_parameters: slab_thermal_mass, slab_heat_transfer, upper/lower_floor_thermal_mass, inter_zone_heat_transfer, window_area) have both their max and their documented example off their own min+k*step grid in HA's default slider mode (12 seams), the same (min, step) pairs the R9 D4-s2-05 fix took off the options flow; and config_flow._widen_to_fit moves a slider's grid base to a stored out-of-range value, putting the field's own default off grid on 28 of 28 slider fields with a constant default.
findings.mechanism: The grid base of an HTML number input and ha-slider is min. #1679 set step "any" on box fields in config_flow._number only; the service surface declares the same min/step pairs in YAML (0.02 + k*0.1 never reaches 0.8 or 5.0), and _widen_to_fit rewrites min to the stored value without snapping it to the field's step, so every nominal value of a widened slider becomes unreachable.

evidence.contention_note: two other D14 seats on the box; the count is contention-immune

findings.title: N-finally-return: one live return-inside-finally seam and no class barrier beyond the single nightly_ha pin
findings.claim: An AST walk of all 1069 .py files in the export finds 1 jump escaping a finally (dev/archive/handoff/r9-f2-solver-4/mutation_proof.py:224, which returns 2 from the restore finally and so discards a KeyboardInterrupt or runner exception in flight from sh()), re-finds the R9 D7-s3-51 seam at 957f4a1ed7^ (tests/nightly_ha.py:1274), and the only shipped guard is tests/entities.py's behavioural pin of that one function.
findings.mechanism: A return/break/continue in a finally body replaces the in-flight exception (PEP 765); CPython 3.14 only emits a SyntaxWarning at compile, which a cached .pyc or a warnings filter hides, and no lint lane makes it an error.

findings.title: P8: the options dialog labels and bounds money in the instance currency while every published figure is in the feed's
findings.claim: On a SEK instance priced by a EUR/kWh entity feed, 5 of 20 money surfaces at 92d38ecb resolve to SEK while the feed and all 13 entity surfaces resolve to EUR: the four options-flow money fields built by config_flow._money (grid_fee_fixed, contract_fixed_price, wood_price_sek_m3, compressor_replacement_cost) and the grid-fee page's currency placeholder; on a HUF instance the grid-fee validation bound (config_flow._fee_placeholders -> grid_fee.fee_bound) is 500 against a feed-scaled 10, a sixth seam; a SEK/kWh feed (null) reads 0.
findings.mechanism: #1657 moved the coordinator to feed-first precedence (coordinator._feed_currency or resolve_currency) but config_flow._money, _fee_placeholders and _grid_fee_errors still call currency.resolve_currency (instance-first). The value typed into those fields is added unconverted to feed-denominated prices (grid_fee.GridFeeSchedule.from_config), so the label names the wrong currency and the implausible-fee bound is scaled by the wrong currency; the price_currency repair names the disagreement but does not remove it.

evidence.unit: money surfaces disagreeing with the feed currency (of 20)
evidence.contention_note: two other D14 seats on the box; the count is contention-immune
